title: Evaluation on the generator for parameterwise scalar continuous procyclic cochains
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with its extended norm topology, a finite intermediate field $E$, and $F=E$ or $F=\Omega$. Use all continuous maps, as in [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring], and the profinite parameter universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Put $H=\mathbf Z_\ell$ with its inverse-limit topology and additive notation. For every profinite set $S$ define a nonnegative complex of abstract $C(S,F)$-modules by
$$U_F^q(S)=C(S\times H^q,F),\qquad
(df)(s;t_1,\ldots,t_{q+1})=f(s;t_2,\ldots,t_{q+1})+\sum_{i=1}^q(-1)^if(s;t_1,\ldots,t_i+t_{i+1},\ldots,t_{q+1})+(-1)^{q+1}f(s;t_1,\ldots,t_q).$$
Here $H^0$ is a point, $d^0=0$, and scalar multiplication is through $S$. Let $K_F(S)$ have $C(S,F)$ in degrees $0,1$, zero elsewhere, and zero differential. The maps
$$\epsilon_S^0=1_{C(S,F)},\qquad \epsilon_S^1(f)(s)=f(s;1),\qquad \epsilon_S^q=0\quad(q\geq2)$$
are natural under every continuous $S'\to S$, including the empty set, and commute with the coefficient inclusion $E\hookrightarrow\Omega$. Thus they define a cochain map $\epsilon:U_F^\bullet\to K_F$ of internal $A_F$-modules, where $A_F(S)=C(S,F)$ [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. This map is a quasi-isomorphism of sheaf complexes: its map on the kernel/image cohomology sheaves is an isomorphism, without taking closures [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. In particular, local existence of primitives is meant in the finite jointly surjective profinite topology; no assertion of a global primitive over every parameter set is imposed. The assertion concerns these explicit underived function-sheaf complexes, not internal condensed right derived invariant functors. The noncomplete norm field $\Omega$ and all its continuous functions are retained.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-continuous-procyclic-low-degree-evaluation] to the Bool-indexed pair F(false)=E and F(true)=Omega, with their isometric Q_l-embeddings and the continuous inclusion E -> Omega. Pack its coordinate, differential, vanishing, scalar, restriction and evaluation clauses into D and D-prime. Its final clauses give the sectionwise H0/H1 isomorphisms and all coefficient-change maps and equations.

proof.text: For E, finite dimensionality over Q_l makes its inherited norm complete by [lem-weil-l-adic-extension-complete]. For every section x killed by d in degree n+2, the coordinate differential and the additive equivalence show that its coordinate z is a closed continuous cochain. Apply [lem-sfb-complete-procyclic-scalar-primitives]. Pull its primitive back through uEval inverse; the identity cover of S is jointly surjective and the differential equation gives the required section primitive.

source.place: Paragraph (3), open direct image; agent-written scalar analytic argument extracted in lem-sfb-procyclic-scalar-cochain-evaluation.

proof.text: For Omega, the same coordinate equation gives dz=0. Postcompose z with the isometric ring map to its complete norm field [lem-sfb-normed-field-completion]. Ring homomorphisms commute with addition, the finite sum and integer scalar multiples, so the completed cochain is closed. Apply [lem-sfb-complete-procyclic-scalar-primitives] over the completion. View additive Z_l as the profinite group Multiplicative Z_l and apply [lem-sfb-parameter-cochain-completion-boundary-descent] to z, its closedness and the completed primitive. Convert its continuous cover maps to profinite morphisms and its primitives through uEval inverse. The restriction and differential coordinate equations yield exactly the local section primitives.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-continuous-scalar-local-quasi-iso] separately to E and Omega using the low-degree section cohomology isomorphisms, local primitives, and source/target support clauses just obtained. This proves both specified evaluation maps are quasi-isomorphisms. Localize these actual maps in the standard derived category: by [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] each is inverted, so asIso gives the required isomorphism with exactly the specified hom. Package the already constructed coefficient maps and their formulas and commuting square.
